instruction_covers: Per-character classification rules: NULL becomes U+FFFD; U+0001-U+001F and U+007F escaped as code point; first-char digit and post-dash digit escaped as code point; lone '-' escaped; >=U+0080, '-', '_', alphanumerics pass through
Passthrough cases such as 'hello', '', 'a1', '--abc', '-a', '-_abc', 'a_b', 'a-b', uppercase, high unicode
Function name 'escape' from the task title; single-string-in/single-string-out shape implied by per-character identifier rules
label: broken
notes: 'From the spec' cites no spec document or section, and the repo/Dockerfile give no serialization reference. The classification rules alone admit many reasonable serializations (e.g. backslash-x, uppercase hex, no trailing space); only the exact CSSOM form passes.

unstated.what: Code-point escapes are serialized as backslash + lowercase hex + trailing space (U+001F -> '\\1f '); instruction only says 'escaped as code point' with no format, case, or terminator
A leading digit is serialized as backslash + its hex code + trailing space ('1' -> '\\31 '); instruction never mentions hex encoding at all
Ordinary-character escapes are serialized as backslash + the character ('-' -> '\\-', '.' -> '\\.', space -> '\\ '); instruction only says 'the escaped character' with no format
